jobs.title: Reservation & Guest Service Agent 80% (w/m/i)
jobs.description:
Reservation & Guest Service Agent 80% (w/m/i) - Bürgenstock Resort --> Eine Ikone der Schweizer Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft. Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa (5* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur. Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz – eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit Stolz erfüllt. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n Reservation & Guest Service Agent 80% (w/m/i) Sie sind primär verantwortlich für die Annahme und Verbuchung von telefonisch, schriftlich oder per E-Mail erfolgten Reservierungen

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Reservation & Guest Service Agent 100% (f/m/i) - Bürgenstock Resort Un'icona tra gli hotel svizzeri: nel 1873 iniziò la storia del Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne, una storia che ancora oggi impressiona e tocca. In cima al Bürgenberg si trova un'oasi di relax e un luogo di ospitalità di prima classe. Il Bürgenstock Resort e i suoi circa 700 dipendenti provenienti da 54 nazioni offrono la cornice perfetta per momenti abbaglianti da ricordare. Tre hotel esclusivi, il Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa (5* Superior) con le due opzioni di pernottamento The Contemporary e The Heritage, il Waldhotel Health & Wellbeing (5* Superior) e la Taverna 1879 (3*) sono a disposizione degli ospiti. Ognuna di queste case sa creare un'atmosfera unica. Dieci ristoranti, bar e lounge sono la vetrina dell'eccellenza culinaria; nella premiata Alpine Spa e Waldhotel Spa gli ospiti trovano il massimo del relax. Il Bürgenstock Resort non è solo una destinazione da sogno per i viaggiatori di tutto il mondo, ma anche un luogo di lavoro con un'eccellente cultura aziendale. Il resort si è classificato al 4° posto tra i migliori datori di lavoro della Svizzera nel 2023 nella categoria gastronomia, turismo, alloggio, intrattenimento e tempo libero e ha ottenuto la certificazione ufficiale di "Great Place to Work" della Svizzera nel 2025. Due riconoscimenti di cui tutto il team è orgoglioso. Mansioni - primario
descriptionByLocale.en: Descrizione Reservation & Guest Service Agent 100% (f/m/i) - Bürgenstock Resort An icon among Swiss hotels: The history of the Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne began in 1873 – a history that still impresses and touches us today. High up on the Bürgenberg is an oasis of relaxation and a place of first-class hospitality. The Bürgenstock Resort and its approximately 700 employees from 54 nations offer the perfect setting for dazzling moments that will be remembered. Three exclusive hotels, the Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa (5* Superior) with the two accommodation options The Contemporary and The Heritage, the Waldhotel Health & Wellbeing (5* Superior) and the Tavern 1879 (3*) are available to guests. Each of these houses knows how to create a unique atmosphere. Ten restaurants, bars & lounges are the showcase for culinary excellence; at the award-winning Alpine Spa and Waldhotel Spa, guests will find the ultimate relaxation. The Bürgenstock Resort is not only a dream destination for travellers from all over the world, but also a workplace with an excellent corporate culture. The resort ranks 4th among Switzerland's best employers in 2023 in the category of gastronomy, tourism, accommodation, entertainment and leisure, and received official certification as Switzerland's "Great Place to Work" in 2025. Two awards that the entire team is proud of. Mansioni - Primary

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ausiliaria/o di cucina - Ausschreibung L’EOC l’ospedale multisito del Ticino è presente con i suoi istituti sull'intero territorio cantonale per un totale di 1’000 posti letto. L’organizzazione permette di combinare efficacemente approccio locale e visione d'insieme, garantendo alla popolazione un'offerta ospedaliera globale e di prossimità, indipendentemente dal luogo in cui sono richiesti i servizi. Grazie all’impegno e alla competenza degli oltre 5’000 collaboratori e alla loro attenzione verso la relazione umana, l’EOC assicura un’assistenza sanitaria di qualità a 380'000 pazienti all’anno. La seguente posizione è rivolta ai candidati che desiderano inoltrare una candidatura spontanea quale Ausiliaria/o di cucina presso la Clinica di Riabilitazione EOC (CREOC) sede di Novaggio Profilo Il/La futuro/a collaboratore/trice esegue, su specifiche direttive del superiore e nel rispetto di programmi, procedure di lavoro predefinite (tempi, modalità, materiali, attrezzature, ecc.) e norme igieniche (es. regole HACCP), tutte le necessarie attività operative all'interno della cucina. Ha una propensione al lavoro in team pur essendo in grado di lavorare in maniera autonoma. Riesce a sostenere i nostri cuochi in attività specifiche a lei/lui assegnate. Persona flessibile, disponibile, precisa, puntuale e polivalente.
• Requisiti necessari esperienze nelle cucine / office o nel ramo alberghiero in funzioni analoghe conoscenze delle tecniche di pulizia e di igiene disponibilità al lavoro a turni, festivi compresi orientamento al cambiamento e allo sviluppo e proprio miglioramento continuo Osservazioni --> Le candidature di coloro che non possiedono i requisiti sopraindicati non saranno prese in alcun caso in considerazione e di conseguenza verranno eliminate dalla nostra banca dati. La valutazione delle candidature verrà fatta solo in caso di esigenze di servizio. Trattandosi di una posizione per candidature spontanee non vengono rilasciate informazioni telefoniche. EOC - insieme per curare meglio. Interessato/a?
descriptionByLocale.en:
Ausiliaria/o di cucina - Ausschreibung L’EOC the multisite hospital of Ticino is present with its institutes on the whole cantonal territory for a total of 1’000 beds. The organization allows to effectively combine local approach and overall vision, ensuring the population a global and proximity hospital offer, regardless of where the services are required. Thanks to the commitment and expertise of over 5,000 employees and their attention to the human relationship, EOC provides quality health care to 380,000 patients per year. The following position is addressed to candidates who wish to apply spontaneously as an Auxiliary/or kitchen at the EOC Rehabilitation Clinic (CREOC) headquarters of Novaggio Profile The future/cooperator performs, on specific directives of the superior and in compliance with programs, predefined working procedures (types, methods, materials, equipment, etc.) and hygienic norms (e.g. HACCP rules). He has a propensity to work in teams while being able to work independently. It can support our cooks in specific activities to you/he assigned. Flexible person, available, precise, punctual and multipurpose.
• Requirements necessary experiences in kitchens / office or in the hotel branch in similar functions knowledge of cleaning and hygiene techniques available to shiftwork, holidays including orientation to change and development and own continuous improvement Observations --> Applications of those who do not have the above requirements will not be taken in any case in consideration and consequently will be eliminated from our database. Applications will be assessed only in case of service requirements. As a position for spontaneous applications, telephone information is not released. EOC - together to cure better. Interested?

jobs.description:
Experience Concierge Manager 100% (w/m/i) - Bürgenstock Resort --> Eine Ikone der Schweizer Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft. Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa (5* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur. Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz – eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit Stolz erfüllt. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n: Experience Concierge Manager 100% (w/m/i) Sie sind primär verantwortlich für Leitung und Inspiration des Experience Concierge und Valet-Teams, um täglich erstklassigen Service zu gewährleisten

descriptionByLocale.it: Esperienza Concierge Manager 100% (f/m/i) - Bürgenstock Resort --> Un'icona tra gli hotel svizzeri: la storia del Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne è iniziata nel 1873 - una storia che continua a stupire e commuovere ancora oggi. In alto sul Bürgenberg si trova un'oasi di relax e un luogo di ospitalità di prima classe. Il Bürgenstock Resort e i suoi circa 700 dipendenti provenienti da 54 nazioni offrono l'ambiente ideale per momenti indimenticabili che verranno ricordati. A disposizione degli ospiti tre esclusivi hotel, il Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa (5* Superior) con i due pernottamenti The Contemporary e The Heritage, il Waldhotel Health & Wellbeing (5* Superior) e la Taverne 1879 (3*). Ognuna di queste case sa creare un'atmosfera unica. Dieci ristoranti, bar e lounge sono la vetrina dell'eccellenza culinaria; Gli ospiti troveranno il massimo relax nella pluripremiata Alpine Spa e nella Waldhotel Spa. Il Bürgenstock Resort non è solo una destinazione da sogno per viaggiatori provenienti da tutto il mondo, ma anche un luogo di lavoro con un'eccellente cultura aziendale. Il resort si è classificato al 4° posto tra i migliori datori di lavoro della Svizzera 2023 nella categoria Gastronomia, turismo, alloggio, intrattenimento e tempo libero e ha ricevuto la certificazione ufficiale come "Great Place to Work" in Svizzera 2025. Due premi di cui l’intero team è orgoglioso. Per rafforzare il nostro team, cerchiamo un Experience Concierge Manager 100% (f/m/i) da maggio 2026 o previo accordo. descriptionByLocale.en: Experience Concierge Manager 100% (f/m/i) - Bürgenstock Resort --> An icon among Swiss hotels: The history of the Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne began in 1873 - a story that continues to impress and touch today. High up on the Bürgenberg lies an oasis of relaxation and a place of first-class hospitality. The Bürgenstock Resort and its around 700 employees from 54 nations offer the perfect setting for dazzling moments that will be remembered. Three exclusive hotels, the Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa (5* Superior) with the two overnight accommodations The Contemporary and The Heritage, the Waldhotel Health & Wellbeing (5* Superior) and the Taverne 1879 (3*) are available to guests. Each of these houses knows how to create a unique atmosphere. Ten restaurants, bars & lounges are the showcase for culinary excellence; Guests will find ultimate relaxation in the award-winning Alpine Spa and Waldhotel Spa. The Bürgenstock Resort is not only a dream destination for travelers from all over the world, but also a workplace with an excellent corporate culture. The resort is ranked 4th among Switzerland's Best Employers 2023 in the Gastronomy, Tourism, Accommodation, Entertainment and Leisure category, and received official certification as a "Great Place to Work" in Switzerland 2025. Two awards that the entire team is proud of. To strengthen our team, we are looking for an Experience Concierge Manager 100% (f/m/i) from May 2026 or by arrangement. You will be primarily responsible for leading and inspiring the Experience Concierge and Valet team to ensure first-class service on a daily basis Quality standards as well as Bürgenstock Resort Standards Maintaining strong partnerships with selected regional providers to enable unique activities and excursions Increasing added value for guests through personalized recommendations and special experiences Personal support of VIP guests as well as coordination of special requests and individual requests Taking over the professional handling of guest feedback and complaints

Housekeeping Manager 100% (w/m/i) - Bürgenstock Resort --> Eine Ikone der Schweizer Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft. Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa (5* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur. Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz – eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit Stolz erfüllt. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir nach Vereinbarung eine/n: Housekeeping Manager 100% (w/m/i)
• Ihre Aufgaben Als Housekeeping Manager (w/m/i) stellen Sie gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team sicher, dass die hohen Standards des Bürgenstock Resorts in den Bereichen Sauberkeit, Servicequalität und Gästekomfort jederzeit gewährleistet sind. In dieser Funktion rapportieren Sie direkt an den Director of Housekeeping und unterstützen ihn bei der operativen sowie strategischen Führung des Verantwortungsbereichs Rooms. Zu Ihren
• Aufgaben gehören: Führung und Weiterentwicklung eines Teams von ca. 50 Mitarbeitenden, darunter Supervisoren, Zimmermädchen und Portiers

Sicherstellung der Reinigung und Pflege von Zimmern sowie öffentlichen Bereichen

Überwachung und Einhaltung von Hygienestandards und Sicherheitsrichtlinien

Effiziente Planung und Organisation der Arbeitsabläufe, Dienstpläne und Ressourcen

Enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Abteilungen, um ein nahtloses Gästeerlebnis zu gewährleisten

Verantwortung für die Budgetkontrolle und die Umsetzung nachhaltiger Reinigungs- und Arbeitsprozesse

Organisation und Überwachung der täglichen Arbeitsabläufe und Personaleinsätze

Motivation und Schulung des Teams, um eine kontinuierliche Qualität und individuelle Entwicklung sicherzustellen

In alto sul Bürgenberg si trova un'oasi di relax e un luogo di ospitalità di prima classe. Il Bürgenstock Resort e i suoi circa 700 dipendenti da 54 nazioni offrono l'ambiente perfetto per momenti abbaglianti che saranno ricordati. Sono a disposizione degli ospiti tre hotel esclusivi, il Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa (5* Superior) con le due opzioni di alloggio The Contemporary and The Heritage, il Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5* Superior) e la Taverna 1879 (3*). Ognuna di queste case sa come creare un'atmosfera unica. Dieci ristoranti, bar e lounge sono la vetrina per l'eccellenza culinaria; Al premiato Alpine Spa e Waldhotel Spa, gli ospiti troveranno il massimo relax. Il Bürgenstock Resort non è solo una destinazione da sogno per i viaggiatori di tutto il mondo, ma anche un posto di lavoro con un'eccellente cultura aziendale. Due premi che riempiono l'intera squadra di orgoglio. Per rafforzare il nostro team, siamo alla ricerca di un Housekeeping Manager 100% (f/m/i) di accordo
• Come Housekeeping Manager (f/m/i), voi e il vostro team assicurate che gli elevati standard del Bürgenstock Resort nei settori della pulizia, della qualità del servizio e del comfort degli ospiti siano sempre garantiti. In questo ruolo, riferisci direttamente al Direttore della Casa e lo sostenga nella gestione operativa e strategica delle Camere. #

jobs.description:
Lehrstelle Kaufmann/-frau (Hotel-Gastro-Tourismus) EFZ - Bürgenstock Resort --> Eine Ikone der Schweizer Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft. Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa (5* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur. Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz – eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit Stolz erfüllt. Ab 1. August 2027 suchen wir ein/e neue/n Lernende/n für die Lehrstelle Kaufmann/-frau (Hotel-Gastro-Tourismus) EFZ Das erwartet dich 3 Jahre Ausbildung in einem führenden Luxus-Destination-Resort inkl. Abschluss mit eidg. Fähigkeitszeugnis EFZ

Einblicke in die Abteilungen Front Office, Guest Service Center, Finance, F&B Administration, Marketing und Human Resources (Abteilungswechsel alle 6 Monate)

Aktive Mitarbeit in allen Teams - von der Entgegennahme von Reservierungen, Kontrolle der Rechnungen, bis zur Organisation von Anlässen

Wöchentlicher Besuch der Berufsschule

Spannende Entwicklungs- und Karrieremöglichkeiten während und nach der Ausbildung

Das bist du Freude im Umgang mit vielen Menschen, fremden Kulturen und Sprachen in einem grossen Unternehmen Interesse an administrativen Arbeiten mit Flair für Zahlen und Arbeit am Computer Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Sekundarschule auf oberer Stufe Zuverlässigkeit und Selbstständigkeit Freundliches und selbstsicheres Auftreten mit sehr guten Umgangsformen Mündliche und schriftliche Sprachgewandtheit in Deutsch und Englisch

Starte deine Zukunft bei uns Bei uns wird's nie langweilig: Dich erwartet eine abwechslungsreiche Ausbildung, bei der du alle 6 Monate die Abteilung und das Team wechselst, viel lernst und im Anschluss durchstarten kannst. Du arbeitest mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus unterschiedlichen Kulturen zusammen, brauchst deine Sprachkenntnisse richtig oft und profitierst von vielen Extras: Ausbildungsförderung: Attraktive finanzielle Unterstützung rund um deine Lehre. Rabatte in unseren Restaurants, auf Hotelübernachtungen (auch für deine Familie!) und weitere Aktivitäten in der Zentralschweiz Vergünstigter Arbeitsweg : Wir unterstützen dich finanziell bei deiner Anreise mit dem öffentlichen Verkehr Digitale Tools : Deinen Dienstplan siehst du bequem auf dem Handy (Favur App) und mit der Beekeeper App bleibst du immer top informiert Ein Arbeitsplatz mit legendären Aussichten : Starte deine Karriere mit einer Berufslehre auf dem Bürgenstock und werde Teil der über 150-jährigen inspirierenden Pionier-Geschichte Wir freuen uns auf deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Motivationsschreiben und Foto. Apprendistato Kaufmann/-frau (Hotel Gastro-Tourism) EFZ - Bürgenstock Resort --> Un'icona dell'industria alberghiera svizzera e una leggenda fin dalla sua sensazionale apertura nel 1873. Situato sul Bürgenberg, un'alta roccia di 500 metri nella Svizzera centrale, il Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne si distingue per il suo design audace, la sostenibilità innovativa, paesaggi mozzafiato e le attività ricreative all'avanguardia. Circa 700 dipendenti da 54 nazioni offrono un'eccellente ospitalità e forniscono l'ambiente perfetto per momenti oltre l'immaginazione. Sono a disposizione degli ospiti tre hotel esclusivi, il Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa (5* Superior) con le due opzioni di alloggio The Contemporary and The Heritage, il Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5* Superior) e la Taverna 1879 (3*). Ognuna di queste case sa come creare un'atmosfera unica. Dodici ristoranti, lounge e bar sono la vetrina per l'eccellenza culinaria; Al premiato Bürgenstock Alpine Spa e Waldhotel Spa, gli ospiti troveranno il massimo relax. Il resort non è solo una destinazione da sogno per i viaggiatori di tutto il mondo, ma anche un posto di lavoro con una cultura aziendale eccellente. Per il terzo anno consecutivo, il Bürgenstock Resort è stato ufficialmente certificato come “Great Place to Work” in Svizzera, un premio che riempie l’intero team con orgoglio. Dal 1° agosto 2027 stiamo cercando un nuovo apprendista per l'apprendistato Kaufmann/-frau (Hotel Gastro Tourism) EFZ Questo vi aspetta 3 anni di formazione in un resort di destinazione di lusso leader incl. Certificato di competenza EFZ

Partecipazione attiva a tutte le squadre - dal ricevimento delle prenotazioni, controllo delle fatture, all'organizzazione degli eventi

Situato sul Bürgenberg, un'alta roccia di 500 metri nella Svizzera centrale, il Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne si distingue per il suo design audace, la sostenibilità innovativa, paesaggi mozzafiato e le attività ricreative all'avanguardia. Lavoro versatile e variegato in tutti gli edifici e la grande area del Bürgenstock Resort

Imparare a utilizzare correttamente diversi strumenti, dispositivi, macchine e veicoli

Un team esperto e ampio che vi insegnerà molto

Visita settimanale alla scuola professionale

Eccitanti opportunità di sviluppo durante e dopo la formazione

Located on the Bürgenberg, a 500-meter-high rocky outcrop in central Switzerland, the Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne stands out for its bold design, groundbreaking sustainability, breathtaking landscapes and state-of-the-art leisure activities. Around 700 employees from 54 nations provide excellent hospitality and provide the perfect setting for moments beyond imagination. Three exclusive hotels, the Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa (5* Superior) with the two accommodation options The Contemporary and The Heritage, the Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5* Superior) and the Tavern 1879 (3*) are available to guests. Certificate of competency EFZ

Versatile and varied work in all buildings and the large area of the Bürgenstock Resort

Learning to use different tools, devices, machines and vehicles correctly

An expert and broad team that will teach you a lot

Weekly visit to vocational school

Exciting development opportunities during and after training

This is you practical-technical understanding and craftsmanship Order-loving, flexible and independent joy in dealing with many people and foreign cultures in a large company team spirit and sociability Physical and mental resilience Remains even in hectic situations calm and friendly High awareness for occupational safety and health protection Completed secondary school Very good German and good English skills

Start your future with us It will never be boring: you can expect a very varied education in an extraordinary place of work. You will learn a lot and can start afterwards. You work with colleagues from different cultures, need your language skills and benefit from many extras: Training support : Attractive financial support around your teaching. Discounts in our restaurants, on hotel stays (also for your family!) and other activities in Central Switzerland Discounted commute : We support you financially when travelling with public transport Digital Tools : You can see your roster conveniently on your mobile phone (Favur app) and with the Beekeeper app you always stay well informed A workplace with legendary prospects : Start your career with a vocational apprenticeship on the Bürgenstock and become part of the more than 150 years of inspiring pioneering history We look forward to your complete application documents with letter of motivation and photo. Formazione completa nel settore alberghiero di lusso con approfondimenti nei reparti di pulizia, lingerie, front office, fioristi, logistica e servizio

descriptionByLocale.en:
Apprenticeship specialist /-mann hotel industry-housekeeping EFZ - Bürgenstock Resort --> An icon of the Swiss hotel industry and a legend since its sensational opening in 1873. Located on the Bürgenberg, a 500-meter-high rocky outcrop in central Switzerland, the Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne stands out for its bold design, groundbreaking sustainability, breathtaking landscapes and state-of-the-art leisure activities. Around 700 employees from 54 nations provide excellent hospitality and provide the perfect setting for moments beyond imagination. Three exclusive hotels, the Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa (5* Superior) with the two accommodation options The Contemporary and The Heritage, the Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5* Superior) and the Tavern 1879 (3*) are available to guests. Each of these houses knows how to create a unique atmosphere. Twelve restaurants, lounges and bars are the showcase for culinary excellence; at the award-winning Bürgenstock Alpine Spa and Waldhotel Spa, guests will find the ultimate relaxation. The resort is not only a dream destination for travelers from all over the world, but also a workplace with an excellent corporate culture. For the third consecutive year, Bürgenstock Resort has been officially certified as a “Great Place to Work” in Switzerland – an award that fills the entire team with pride. From 1 August 2027 we are looking for a new apprentice for the apprenticeship Fachfrau/-mann Hotel-Hauswirtschaft EFZ This awaits you 3 years of training in a leading luxury destination resort with a federal degree. Certificate of competency EFZ

Comprehensive training in the upscale hotel industry with in-depth insights into the departments Housekeeping, Lingerie, Front Office, Floristry, Logistics and Service

Completion of work according to the hotel standards of the 5-star hotel industry

Block lessons in spring and autumn

Exciting development opportunities during and after training

This is your pleasure in dealing with many people and foreign cultures in a large company sense of order and cleanliness Flexibility and resilience also in hectic situations Joy of organizational activities and independent work Completed secondary school Readiness for irregular working hours also on weekends Oral and written fluency in German and English, other languages are advantageous

Start your future with us It never gets boring: You can expect a very varied training, in which you regularly change the fields of application and teams, learn a lot and then start. You work with colleagues from different cultures, need your language skills very often and benefit from many extras: Training support : Attractive financial support around your teaching. Discounts in our restaurants, on hotel stays (also for your family!) and other activities in Central Switzerland Discounted commute : We support you financially when travelling with public transport Digital Tools : You can see your roster conveniently on your mobile phone (Favur app) and with the Beekeeper app you always stay well informed A workplace with legendary prospects : Start your career with a vocational apprenticeship on the Bürgenstock and become part of the more than 150 years of inspiring pioneering history We look forward to your complete application documents with letter of motivation and photo. BÜRGENSTOCK HOTELS AG Tamara Würzer Junior HR Business Partner & Young Talents Bürgenstock 30 6363 Obbürgen +41 41 612 61 73 tamara.wuerzer@burgenstockresort.com

Spa Service Agent (f/m/i) 100% - Bürgenstock Resort --> Un'icona tra gli hotel svizzeri: nel 1873 iniziò la storia del Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne, una storia che ancora oggi colpisce e tocca. In alto sul Bürgenberg si trova un'oasi di relax e un luogo di ospitalità di prima classe. Il Bürgenstock Resort e i suoi circa 700 dipendenti da 54 nazioni offrono l'ambiente perfetto per momenti abbaglianti che saranno ricordati. Sono a disposizione degli ospiti tre hotel esclusivi, il Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa (5* Superior) con le due opzioni di alloggio The Contemporary and The Heritage, il Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5* Superior) e la Taverna 1879 (3*). Ognuna di queste case sa come creare un'atmosfera unica. Dieci ristoranti, bar e lounge sono la vetrina per l'eccellenza culinaria; Al premiato Alpine Spa e Waldhotel Spa, gli ospiti troveranno il massimo relax. Il Bürgenstock Resort non è solo una destinazione da sogno per i viaggiatori di tutto il mondo, ma anche un posto di lavoro con un'eccellente cultura aziendale. Il resort è classificato 4° tra i migliori datori di lavoro in Svizzera nel 2023 nella categoria gastronomia, turismo, alloggio, intrattenimento e tempo libero, e ha ricevuto la certificazione ufficiale come "Great Place to Work" in Svizzera nel 2026. Due premi che riempiono l'intera squadra di orgoglio. Per rafforzare il nostro team, stiamo cercando un agente Spa Service (f/m/i) 100% da settembre 2026 Le sue responsabilità includono le seguenti attività: accoglienza, supporto, pianificazione e fatturazione di servizi benessere con gli ospiti del giorno e dell'hotel

Informare gli ospiti sulla gamma completa di servizi benessere e strutture termali, nonché visite guidate della Alpine Spa

Vendita attiva dell'intera gamma di prodotti, fidelizzazione del cliente, cross-selling per trattamenti spa

Supporto per attirare e prendersi cura dei nostri membri del centro benessere

Pulizia giornaliera presso la spa e il controllo del posto di lavoro

Assistenza Generale presso la Spa

Stiamo affrontando una personalità ben posizionata e orientata al servizio con esperienza in una posizione paragonabile nel segmento del lusso internazionale. Vieni dall'industria alberghiera o dall'area benessere e il benessere dell'ospite è sempre la vostra priorità. Attraverso la vostra formazione, avete familiarità con i processi di un front office e preferibilmente familiarità con l'implementazione degli standard LQA. Immaginiamo una personalità indipendente e motivata che è affidabile e si diverte a lavorare in una squadra. Parlano tedesco fluente e inglese e possono comunicare in altre lingue straniere, sono preferibilmente familiarità con il sistema di prenotazione TAC e hanno una buona conoscenza MS-Office.

Vi aspetta un'attività versatile in una grande squadra e con molti vantaggi, come la casa del personale con palestra, sala TV, sala piscina e biblioteca. Riceverai sconti nei ristoranti, in hotel per soggiorni di notte per te e per la tua famiglia e per i tuoi amici, sconti per tennis, golf, articoli sportivi e assicurazione e servizi medici. È possibile frequentare corsi di gruppo a prezzi interessanti e ottenere controlli REKA da noi in termini preferenziali. Il viaggio con i mezzi pubblici è supportato finanziariamente dall'azienda e i parcheggi sono offerti a prezzi interessanti. Come dipendente, si ottiene l'accesso all'app dipendente Beekeeper, beneficiare di interessanti ulteriori opportunità di formazione e promozione interna e altro ancora. Se si identifica anche con i nostri valori di entusiasmo, impegno, responsabilità e imprenditorialità (BEvU), allora prendere questa opportunità unica di un compito vario con un sacco di potenziale per imparare cose nuove e contribuire al successo del resort di livello mondiale nel cuore della Svizzera. Attendiamo con ansia i vostri documenti di applicazione completi con lettere di motivazione, certificati di lavoro e foto. Se ti piace avere a che fare con gli ospiti, sono comunicativi e resilienti e non timidi lontano dai compiti del fine settimana, sei al posto giusto con noi. Cogliete l'occasione unica di un compito vario con il potenziale di imparare nell'ambiente montano più bello. Two awards that fill the entire team with pride. Inform guests about the full spectrum of wellness services and spa facilities as well as guided tours of the Alpine Spa

Proactive sale of the entire product range, customer loyalty, cross-selling for spa treatments

Support in attracting and taking care of our spa members

Daily cleanup at the spa and control of the workplace

General Assistance at the Spa

We are addressing a well-positioned and service-oriented personality with experience in a comparable position in the international luxury segment. You come from the hotel industry or the wellness area and the well-being of the guest is always your top priority. Through your training, you are familiar with the processes of a front office and preferably familiar with the implementation of LQA standards. We imagine an independent and motivated personality who is reliable and enjoys working in a team. They speak fluent German and English and can communicate in other foreign languages, are preferably familiar with the TAC reservation system and have good MS-Office knowledge.

It awaits you a versatile activity in a great team and with many benefits, such as the staff house with gym, TV lounge, pool room and library. You will receive discounts in the restaurants, in the hotel for overnight stays for you and your family and friends, discounts for tennis, golf, sporting goods as well as insurance and medical services. You can attend group courses at attractive prices and obtain REKA checks from us on preferential terms. The journey by public transport is financially supported by the company and the parking spaces are offered at attractive prices. As an employee, you get access to the Beekeeper employee app, benefit from interesting further education and internal promotion opportunities and more. If you also identify with our values of enthusiasm, commitment, responsibility and entrepreneurship (BEvU), then take this unique opportunity of a varied task with a lot of potential to learn new things and contribute to the success of the world-class resort in the heart of Switzerland. We look forward to your complete application documents with letters of motivation, employment certificates and photo. If you enjoy dealing with guests, are communicative and resilient and do not shy away from weekend assignments, you are at the right place with us. Take the unique opportunity of a varied task with the potential to learn in the most beautiful mountain environment. Description Head Sommelier 100% (f/m/i) - Bürgenstock Resort --> An icon among Swiss hotels: The history of the Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne began in 1873 - a story that continues to impress and touch today. High up on the Bürgenberg lies an oasis of relaxation and a place of first-class hospitality. The Bürgenstock Resort and its around 700 employees from 54 nations offer the perfect setting for dazzling moments that will be remembered. Three exclusive hotels, the Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa (5* Superior) with the two overnight accommodations The Contemporary and The Heritage, the Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5* Superior) and the Taverne 1879 (3*) are available to guests. Each of these houses knows how to create a unique atmosphere. Ten restaurants, bars & lounges are the showcase for culinary excellence; Guests will find ultimate relaxation in the award-winning Alpine Spa and Waldhotel Spa. The Bürgenstock Resort is not only a dream destination for travelers from all over the world, but also a workplace with an excellent corporate culture. The resort is ranked 4th among the best employers in Switzerland 2023 in the gastronomy, tourism, accommodation, entertainment and leisure category, and received official certification as a "Great Place to Work" in Switzerland 2025. Two awards that the entire team is proud of. To strengthen our team, we are looking for one from now on in 2026 or by appointment: Head Sommelier 100% (f/m/i) With over 1,200 positions in the wine cellar, the Bürgenstock Resort is an address that delights wine lovers from all over the world. As Head Sommelier (100%), you will take responsibility for the design and strategic direction of our wine range, lead a motivated sommelier team and set new standards in wine and gastronomy culture. This is what awaits you - your stage for excellence Strategic responsibility: design and maintenance of the wine lists as well as strategic orientation of the wine range in coordination with the Director of F&B Operational perfection: wine purchasing for the entire resort, including selection of suppliers, price negotiations and contract processing Sales and advice: planning and advice on wine selection at events, active wine sales to guests as well as conducting wine tastings Team leadership: recruiting, leading and developing a motivated sommelier team as well as creating rosters Quality assurance: order and care of the wine cellar, daily wine distribution to the outlets as well as compliance with budget requirements in terms of sales and cost of goods Further education and training: Carrying out wine training courses for service employees and promoting wine knowledge throughout the entire team
• Requisiti - Professional foundation: Training in gastronomy/hotel industry and completion of certified further training to become a sommelier at a recognized academy - Experience and competence: Several years of experience as a responsible sommelier in upscale gastronomy - Linguistic diversity: Fluent in German and English, other foreign languages Advantage - Culinary sensitivity: In-depth knowledge of the interaction of food and drinks - Personal strength: sense of responsibility, independence and innovative spirit, coupled with flexibility and resilience - Intercultural sensitivity: experience in dealing with national and international guests as well as in leading teams
• Cosa offriamo - Working where excellence is at home A varied task awaits you in a committed team and in a working environment that combines style, quality and well-being. - Our modern staff house offers you space to relax and recharge, with a fitness studio, TV lounge, billiards room and library. - As part of the resort, you benefit from attractive discounts in our restaurants and bars, on hotel stays, leisure activities such as tennis or golf and on selected insurance policies. - We support you with your journey by public transport and offer parking spaces at attractive conditions. - You can always stay connected via our Beekeeper app, and exciting further training and internal advancement opportunities open up new perspectives for you. - If you share our values ​​of enthusiasm, commitment, responsibility and entrepreneurship (BEvU), you have come to the right place. - Become part of a team that lives hospitality at the highest level - with heart, standards and passion. - Now it's your turn! Become part of a team that inspires every day with passion, creativity and a sense of excellence. - At the Bürgenstock Resort, elegance, views and atmosphere come together to create a special place for sophisticated moments of enjoyment - make it your stage! - Show us how you would like to enrich this place with your personality, your style and your experience. - For us, it's not just what you do that counts - but how you do it: with heart, sensitivity and genuine hospitality. - Apply now with your letter of motivation, CV, references and current photo. - Let’s create unforgettable experiences together – for our guests and for you. Awards - Swiss Location Awards "Switzerland's best meeting location" - World Travel Awards "Switzerland's Leading Luxury Hotel 2024" - World Spa Awards "World's, Europe's & Switzerland's Best Hotel Spa 2024" - LHW Membership Awards "Remarkable Experience Award 2023" - Great Place To Work 2025 - The New York Times' "52 Places to Go in 2018" - Travel + Leisure "500 List 2021" - Handelszeitung "Best Employer in the Hospitality Sector 2023" - Falstaff Magazine "Best Hotel in Switzerland - No. 1" - Wine Spectator 2024 "Best Award of Excellence" - Swiss Bar Awards "Best Hotel Bar" Contatto BÜRGENSTOCK HOTELS AG Sabine Heinrich Junior HR Business Partner Bürgenstock 30 6363 Obbürgen

Assistant Restaurant Manager 100% (m/f/i) - Bürgenstock Resort An icon among Swiss hotels: the history of the Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne began in 1873 – a story that continues to impress and touch to this day. High up on the Bürgenberg lies an oasis of relaxation and a place of first-class hospitality. The Bürgenstock Resort and its approximately 700 employees from 54 nations offer the perfect setting for vibrant moments that become memorable. Three exclusive hotels, the Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa (5* Superior) with the two overnight options The Contemporary and The Heritage, the Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5* Superior), and the Taverne 1879 (3*) are available to guests. Each of these establishments knows how to create a unique atmosphere. Ten restaurants, bars & lounges serve as showcases for culinary excellence; guests can find ultimate relaxation in the award-winning Alpine Spa and Waldhotel Spa. The Bürgenstock Resort is not only a dream destination for travelers from around the world but also a workplace with an excellent corporate culture. The resort ranked 4th among the best employers in Switzerland in 2023 in the categories of gastronomy, tourism, accommodation, entertainment, and leisure, and received the official certification as a "Great Place to Work" in Switzerland in 2025. Two awards that fill the entire team with pride. To strengthen our team, we are looking for an immediate or by agreement: Assistant Restaurant Manager 100% (m/f/i) Our restaurant combines excellent cuisine with warm hospitality in a unique atmosphere. As Assistant Manager, you support the Restaurant Manager in operational management, ensure the highest quality standards, and promote the development of the team. Support the Restaurant Manager in the daily operation of the restaurant and ensure smooth processes. Assist in creating duty rosters with Mirus 3.0 and optimize staffing resources. Develop and conduct internal training sessions on operational guidelines, our offerings, and the ongoing development of employees. Ensure and monitor all hygiene and quality standards for impeccable guest service. What you bring – Your recipe for success: Completed training in gastronomy/hospitality or a degree from a hotel management school. Professional experience in a comparable position and confident handling of Micros Symphonie. Experience in upscale hotel operations. Fluent German and English skills; any additional foreign language is a plus. Sense of responsibility, flexibility, resilience, and a strong awareness of quality. Sensitivity when dealing with international guests, enjoyment of leading staff, and a charismatic demeanor. What we offer you – Work where excellence is at home: You can expect a varied role in a dedicated team and in a work environment that combines style, quality, and well-being. Our modern staff house offers space to relax and recharge, with a fitness studio, TV lounge, billiard room, and library. As part of the resort, you benefit from attractive discounts in our restaurants and bars, hotel stays, leisure activities such as tennis or golf, and selected insurance options. We support your commute with public transportation and offer parking at attractive rates. Through our Beekeeper app, you stay connected at all times, and exciting further training and internal advancement opportunities open up new perspectives for you. If you share our values of enthusiasm, commitment, responsibility, and entrepreneurship (BEvU), you are exactly right with us. Become part of a team that lives hospitality at the highest level – with heart, standards, and passion. Now it’s your turn! Become part of a team that inspires daily with passion, creativity, and a sense of excellence. At Bürgenstock Resort, elegance, views, and atmosphere come together to create a special place for demanding moments of enjoyment – make it your stage! Show us how you want to enrich this place with your personality, style, and experience. For us, it’s not just about what you do – but how you do it: with heart, sensitivity, and genuine hospitality. Apply now with your motivation letter, CV, work references, and a recent photo. Let’s create unforgettable experiences together – for our guests and for you. Awards:

Annahme, Prüfung, Sortierung, Lagerung und Ausgabe der Wäsche

Koordination der Zusammenarbeit mit der externen Wäscherei sowie internen Abteilungen

Optimierung von Abläufen und Sicherstellung eines effizienten Waren- und Wäscheflusses im Resort

Organizzazione dell'intero ciclo di lavanderia e controllo e gestione delle scorte di lavanderia

Accettazione, collaudo, smistamento, stoccaggio e consegna della lavanderia

Coordinamento della cooperazione con la lavanderia esterna e i dipartimenti interni

Ottimizzare i processi e garantire un flusso efficiente di merci e lavanderia nel resort

Prima persona di contatto per tutti gli argomenti relativi alla logistica della lavanderia

Avete esperienza iniziale nel campo della logistica della lavanderia e del lavoro in questa zona orientata alla soluzione. Portano una patente di categoria B e godono di lavorare dentro e fuori. Spa & Wellness Attendant 100% (w/m/i) - Bürgenstock Resort --> Eine Ikone der Schweizer Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft. Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa (5* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur. Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz – eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit Stolz erfüllt. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab August 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung eine Persönlichkeit als Spa & Wellness Attendant 100% (w/m/i)
• Ihre Aufgaben: Die Reinigung und der Unterhalt der Spa Anlagen (Innen und Aussenbereich)

Aufräumen, Aufwischen, Desinfizieren und Abstauben der Saunaräumlichkeiten, Umkleidekabinen, Toiletten, Poolanlagen sowie der Behandlungs- und Fitnessräume

Betreuen der SPA-Gäste sowie die Aufsicht im ganzen Spa Bereich

Auffüllen von Verbrauchmaterialien sowie allgemeine Aufräumarbeiten im Spa

Ihr Profil: Erfahrungen im Housekeeping oder in der Spa Reinigung setzten wir voraus körperlich Belastbar, um auch in sehr warmen Räumen arbeiten zu können (Innenpool, Sauna, Garderobe usw.) gepflegtes, freundliches und zuvorkommendes Auftreten Sie sprechen Deutsch oder Englisch Freude im Umgaben mit den Spa Gästen und im Team zu arbeiten Bereitschaft für Schicht- und Wochenendarbeit

Stv. Leitung Sicherheit 100% (m/w/i) - Bürgenstock Resort --> Eine Ikone der Schweizer Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft. Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa (5* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur. Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz – eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit Stolz erfüllt. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab August 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung eine Persönlichkeit als Stv. Leitung Sicherheit 100% (m/w/i)
• Ihre Aufgaben: Unterstützung des Head of Security bei der Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung der Sicherheitsprozesse und -richtlinien

Mitarbeit bei der Erstellung und Implementierung von Sicherheitsrichtlinien und Notfallplänen

Führung, Koordination und Einsatzplanung des Sicherheitspersonals

Organisation und Durchführung von Schulungen zu Sicherheitsprotokollen und -verfahren

Gewährleistung der Sicherheit von Gästen und Mitarbeitenden

Durchführung von Zutrittskontrollen sowie Überwachung öffentlicher Bereiche

Bearbeitung und Nachverfolgung sicherheitsrelevanter Anfragen und Vorfälle

Installation, Wartung und Überwachung von Sicherheitssystemen (CCTV, Zutrittskontrollen und Alarmanlagen)

Stv. Leiter/in Sicherheit (m/f/i) - Bürgenstock Resort --> Un'icona tra gli hotel svizzeri: nel 1873 iniziò la storia del Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne, una storia che ancora oggi colpisce e tocca. In alto sul Bürgenberg si trova un'oasi di relax e un luogo di ospitalità di prima classe. Il Bürgenstock Resort e i suoi circa 700 dipendenti da 54 nazioni offrono l'ambiente perfetto per momenti abbaglianti che saranno ricordati. Sono a disposizione degli ospiti tre hotel esclusivi, il Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa (5* Superior) con le due opzioni di alloggio The Contemporary and The Heritage, il Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5* Superior) e la Taverna 1879 (3*). Ognuna di queste case sa come creare un'atmosfera unica. Dieci ristoranti, bar e lounge sono la vetrina per l'eccellenza culinaria; Al premiato Alpine Spa e Waldhotel Spa, gli ospiti troveranno il massimo relax. Il Bürgenstock Resort non è solo una destinazione da sogno per i viaggiatori di tutto il mondo, ma anche un posto di lavoro con un'eccellente cultura aziendale. Il resort è classificato 4° tra i migliori datori di lavoro in Svizzera nel 2023 nella categoria gastronomia, turismo, alloggio, intrattenimento e tempo libero, e ha ricevuto la certificazione ufficiale come "Great Place to Work" in Svizzera nel 2026. Due premi che riempiono l'intera squadra di orgoglio. Per rafforzare il nostro team, cercheremo una personalità come Stv. Leiter/in Sicherheits da agosto 2026 o per accordo (m/f/i)

Gestione, coordinamento e pianificazione operativa del personale di sicurezza

Garantire la sicurezza degli ospiti e del personale

Attuazione dei controlli di accesso e del monitoraggio delle aree pubbliche

Trattamento e monitoraggio delle richieste e degli incidenti legati alla sicurezza

Installazione, manutenzione e monitoraggio dei sistemi di sicurezza (CCTV, controllo accessi e sistemi di allarme)

Stv. Leiter/in Sicherheit (m/f/i) - Bürgenstock Resort --> An icon among Swiss hotels: in 1873 the history of the Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne began – a story that still impresses and touches today. High up on the Bürgenberg lies an oasis of relaxation and a place of first-class hospitality. The Bürgenstock Resort and its approximately 700 employees from 54 nations offer the perfect setting for dazzling moments that will be remembered. Three exclusive hotels, the Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa (5* Superior) with the two accommodation options The Contemporary and The Heritage, the Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5* Superior) and the Tavern 1879 (3*) are available to guests. Each of these houses knows how to create a unique atmosphere. Ten restaurants, bars & lounges are the showcase for culinary excellence; At the award-winning Alpine Spa and Waldhotel Spa, guests will find the ultimate relaxation. The Bürgenstock Resort is not only a dream destination for travelers from all over the world, but also a workplace with an excellent corporate culture. The resort is ranked 4th among the best employers in Switzerland in 2023 in the category gastronomy, tourism, accommodation, entertainment and leisure, and received the official certification as "Great Place to Work" in Switzerland in 2026. Two awards that fill the entire team with pride. In order to strengthen our team, we will be looking for a personality as Stv. Leiter/in Sicherheits from August 2026 or by agreement (m/f/i)
• Your tasks: Supporting the Head of Security in the implementation and further development of security processes and policies

Assistance in the creation and implementation of safety policies and emergency plans

Management, coordination and operational planning of security personnel

Organisation and conduct of training on security protocols and procedures

Ensuring the safety of guests and staff

Implementation of access controls and monitoring of public areas

Processing and tracking of security-related requests and incidents

Installation, maintenance and monitoring of security systems (CCTV, access control and alarm systems)
